verdict.rationale: Honeycomb ingests data through vendor-neutral OpenTelemetry/OTLP, so instrumentation can be repointed elsewhere without rework, which eases leaving. Its API lets you manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs and environments, and it publishes a downloadable OpenAPI spec, so configuration can likely be retrieved programmatically. However, nothing in the evidence shows a bulk export of stored telemetry (events, traces, logs) in an open format. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of raw stored telemetry, explicit export formats for boards/queries/config, any first-party offboarding or data-portability guidance, and independent corroboration of a successful migration away.
